title: Truly magnificent performance
text: This Flamenco show and museum is well worth it. The dancers, singers and guitarist were all excellent performers - so passionate and entertaining. 10/10- the music and dancing were so emotional and I'd recommend it if visiting Seville.
author: wonderwoman41

title: "Flamingos" concert
text: The show was very good, excellent artists, even my 5-year-old son loved the "flamingos" concert and already wanted to go back today. The museum was a little below expectations.

title: Beautiful show and museum as well.
text:
Interesting museum but a bit short.
Great show!
2 singers, a super guitarist, and 3 very talented dancers (2 women and 1 man).
All with a glass of Sangria (for purchase), which was welcome given the outside temperature.
author: Marie_V

title: Flamenco Show
text:
We happened to visit this museum that day.  Incredible luck, the dance show started at noon when we arrived. 
Incredible! What an emotion!
Two singers, one guitarist, and three dancers.
They are true professionals. It was absolutely magical.

title: AMAZING FOR BOTH!
text:
AMAZING FOR BOTH!
My daughter does a lot of Flamenco dancing in England and whilst we were in Seville, a visit to the museum was a "must".
It is a really well laid out museum, full of character, feels like the essence of Flamenco is all around you. My daughter understood a lot more than I did, abut the things like different techniques, which are explained, but I was totally mesmerised by the whole experience, could have spent hours in there, except we had to stop our viewing, to join the queue for the show at 5pm.  Suggest you arrive early, as the queue soon builds up, and seating is on a "fir
author: gaynors106
